nativePhysicalPhases.setup: Native Rust optimized test build (-C opt-level=3), one pinned core; identical 120-step trajectories after ten warmup ticks, alternating run order. First pair discarded. Timings exclude setup and checkpoint hashing.

cases.workload: 1600 × 1000; 4,000 patches; ambient current, vortex, heater, nutrient inlet and sink, three walls (two floating), integer dissolved transport.
1,536 seeded scavenger bodies in the same geography; repeated contact solver passes. The bodies move under contact resolution only during this isolated benchmark.

wasmWholeTicks.note: Release WASM in Node/V8. Tick and Rust export timings exclude JS hydration/copies, worker transfer/scheduling, main-thread rendering and setup. Medians of identical trajectories with alternating engine order. The paired engines differ only in the physical optimizations. ABI 23 isolates them from the later chemistry and habitat changes.
wasmWholeTicks.tissuePreparation: Scattered ordinary founders start in anoxic water with a sealed surface. Their ATP is withdrawn to one ATP count before one upkeep tick per cohort. The scenario surface boundary is restored before seeding resident populations and warming the world.
wasmWholeTicks.equivalence: Canonical checkpoints and legacy world/environment buffers must match exactly. Compact projections match those legacy values; only metrics header[13] (genomeBytes) is normalized because derived execution-plan storage is now counted.
